mathematics.full_product: For actual Boolean64-bit operands, primitive g in GF(2^128), exponent equality plus a0*b0=lo0 is equivalent to a*b=lo+2^64*hi. The parity check is present in the actual source.
mathematics.endpoint: Product lies in [0,(2^64-1)^2], result pair in [0,2^128-1]. The only unequal same-exponent pair is product0/result2^128-1, rejected by parity.
mathematics.actual_field: Caller selects B128. Field and generator implementation correctness remain hypotheses, not a trait-name theorem.
mathematics.five_phases: 64-leaf product reduction, inverse Frobenius of point and value, selector/output product batch, three four-limb trees with zero pad, committed transparent-table lookup plus index/parity/b rerandomization.
mathematics.table: Four16-bit limbs per word, twelve columns. Public65536-row table MLE is product of fixed generator-power selects. Pushforward oracle and its openings remain required.
mathematics.operand_binding: Actual return arrays[a,b,lo,hi], before later AND challenge, same source-indexed trace and real native fixed-program wiring consumer.
mathematics.canonical_source: Two-bit segment/30-bit index, scratch forbidden, per-segment bounds, two ordered shifts, XOR vector operands with repeated-term cancellation. Irreducible shift pairs need not be unique as maps.
mathematics.conditional_maps: Honest original word assignment supplies selected algebraic relations. Valid same-source committed Boolean columns and every complete reduction/opening relation imply original full unsigned products. Neither direction is a runtime or accepted-proof theorem.

execution.scope: Local source and mathematical review. Existing separately authorized repository CI is distinct evidence.
